main_turf.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise (left-handed). Iconic Western Victorian country track featuring a 1,660m oval, live-box hedge jumps, and a short 320m home straight. The tight turning configuration and brief home stretch generate a strong bias toward early front-runners ('E') and pocket pressers ('P'). Sweeping closers ('Swoopers') must make their move early into the turn.
main_turf.post_bias: INSIDE BARRIER BIAS: Inside barriers (stalls 1–4) in 1000m, 1200m, and 1400m races hold a major advantage to hold the rail into the bend. Wide draws (8+) face severe ground-loss penalties.

handicapping_angles.short_320m_straight_speed_bias: Aggressively upgrade lone early speed ('E') and rail-skimming tactical pressers ('P'). Downgrade deep back-markers lacking gate speed.
handicapping_angles.south_australian_border_and_warrnambool_: Casterton sits near the SA border and receives high-volume shippers from Warrnambool, Hamilton, Geelong, and SA Limestone Coast yards (Symon Wilde, Paul Preusker, Lindsey Smith, Tom Dabernig). Upgrade Victorian provincial and SA shippers (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.casterton_cup_carnival: During the Casterton Cup ($50k+) Showcase meeting in May, race quality elevates to Victorian Provincial level.
